definition: JMJD3 (Jumonji domain-containing protein 3) is an alternative name for KDM6B (lysine-specific demethylase 6B), a histone demethylase that demethylates trimethylated lysine-27 on histone H3 (H3K27) to regulate gene expression during development, and whose pathogenic variants cause Stolerman neurodevelopmental syndrome.

source.title: Genetic variants in the KDM6B gene are associated with neurodevelopmental delays and dysmorphic features
source.quote: JMJD3 (the alternative name for KDM6B) demethylate
